_meta.notes: Top 5 suppliers per importer-commodity. ~25 priority importers (free-tier quota). Succeeded: 287/290, re-queued: 49, skipped: 3. Coverage this run: 19 importers / 189 importer-commodity pairs (previous file: 19 / 189). Rate-limited (429) calls are re-queued up to 3 times rather than dropped, and a coverage regression caused by failed calls keeps the previous file instead of overwriting it. v45: values count Comtrade aggregate rows only (motCode=0 AND partner2Code=0). The public-preview endpoint also returns per-transport-mode and per-second-partner copies of the same trade; summing all rows overstated USD totals for a subset of importers by ~3-11x (GBR 4.00x, DEU 3.05x, ESP ~11x; EGY/ITA/NLD were unaffected). Dropped 18208 breakout rows this run. Values are raw USD despite the legacy usd_m / total_usd_m field names.
